pattern.name: basic_page_object
pattern.template:
# FN:<filename>_page.py """ FN:<filename>_page.py Contains 1 class. Page Object for <Page Name>.
Primary: <ClassName>.__init__
Classes: - <ClassName>: Page Object for <Page Name>
Functions: - FN:__init__: Initialize page object (lines X-Y) - FN:navigate: Navigate to page (lines X-Y) - FN:verify_loaded: Verify page loaded (lines X-Y) """
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect
class <ClassName>: """FN:<ClassName> - Page Object for <Page Name>."""
def __init__(self, page: Page): """FN:__init__ - Initialize with Page instance.""" self.page = page
def navigate(self): """FN:navigate - Navigate to the page.""" self.page.goto(self.URL)
def verify_loaded(self): """FN:verify_loaded - Verify page is loaded.""" expect(self.page).to_have_title(self.TITLE)
